data.name: Murashih
data.gender_notes: Murashih is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Murashih is derived from the Arabic root 'r-sh-h' which means 'to send, to report, or to convey a message'. In Islamic context, it can be interpreted as a name for a messenger or someone who carries important news. The name Murashih carries the meaning “Report, Message, News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murashih usually hope their child will grow to embody report, message, news and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murashih total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
